summary: Iteration 6 verified the new Rodomisto Rappresentanze flows end-to-end. Backend: 12/12 focused pytest cases PASSED in /app/backend/tests/test_iter6_new_flows.py (payment mode 'rifatturazione_pac' present with days=null and order event has due_at=null + no suspension, bonfissuto Catanzaro verso Lamezia Terme contains Eurodrink & NOT Excalibur for natale+pasqua, DELETE /api/recurrences/bonfissuto/members/{id} removes only from that ricorrenza while client stays in anagrafica + giro + mazzetti, agente Andrea gets 403 removing a non-owned member, GET /api/giri returns exactly the 7 giri in the new order, /api/clients/da-verificare returns 12 clients with all required fields, PUT /api/clients/{id} with giro_id clears extra.needs_review and removes the client from /clients/da-verificare, regression login umberto+andrea OK and agente_60 order due_at = created_at + 60d). Full backend suite (91 tests) shows 4 pre-existing tests failing that are STALE and expected to fail after the data/spec updates (Excalibur removed from bonfissuto changes the per-group totals, 8th payment mode rifatturazione_pac added, da_verificare count changed) — these are TEST fixture updates, not product bugs. Frontend (mobile 390x844, Expo web preview): (a) 'Da Verificare' tab shows 12 rows with 'Assegna' badge, tapping opens Conferma/Assegna modal showing client info + all 7 giri in the exact expected order + 'Conferma e assegna al giro' + 'Lascia da verificare' buttons; (b) Ricorrenze -> Bonfissuto shows real-time search field, 'Eurodrink' filter shows Eurodrink under 'CATANZARO VERSO LAMEZIA TERME', 'Excalibur' filter shows 'Nessun cliente trovato' (confirming removal end-to-end), clear (X) works, and 12 trash 'Rimuovi dalla ricorrenza' icons render on member rows; (c) Dashboard giro shows the 7 giri in exact expected order in the selection modal, and inside the Ordine effettuato flow the 'Modalità di pagamento' sheet exposes all 8 modes including 'Rifatturazione Pac' as a selectable option. Pre-existing RN-web deprecation warnings only (shadow* -> boxShadow, props.pointerEvents), no red screen, no runtime errors. Cleanup performed: soft-deleted TEST_ clients (6) and TEST_ events after the assign flow.
